subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: zaman can you tell me what i am teaching the teacher asked i m sorry sir i can't follow replied zaman you can't because you are not attentive the teacher said Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: "Zaman, can you tell me what I am teaching?" the teacher asked. "I'm sorry, sir, I can't follow," replied Zaman. "You can't because you are not attentive," the teacher said.
